thread_messages.snippet: <external_source>Job invite from recruiter. Apply now! You've been chosen from a large pool of jobseekers to apply for this job. Make the most of this opportunity and stay ahead in your job search. naukri.com Get</external_source>
thread_messages.body: <external_source>Job invite from recruiter. Apply now! You've been chosen from a large pool of jobseekers to apply for this job. Make the most of this opportunity and stay ahead in your job search. Get app Surojit Dutta, as a Naukri Pro member, you're invited to apply to this exclusive job Hiring for Foreign MNC Posted by Ultimate Search Agentic AI Developer - with one of the Big 4 consulting firms Bengaluru, Bangalore Rural 3 - 8 years Not Disclosed In office Agentic AI, Machine Learning, Python, ML, Deep Learning, GenAI Apply now Job description Dear Candidate , Greetings ! At present we have multiple urgent opening with Deloitte . Job Title: Agentic AI Developer Consultant and Senior Consultant Please Note: The candidates would be under the direct payroll of RVAI Global and would be deployed to the client site Deloitte Job Location : Bangalore (Work From Office), General shift timings Experience : Agentic AI Developer – Consultant : 3 to 5 years, Senior Consultant : 5 to 8 years Work you’ll do Understand the business use case, conduct preliminary analysis and propose potential solutions using statistical and Agentic AI / ML techniques to solve the client’s problems. Perform feasibility analysis of proposed solutions through data exploration and building proof of concept using Agentic AI/ ML etc. Supervise and train a team of consultants in building GenAI/ Agentic AI Platform. Work in a highly collaborative atmosphere of consultants and team leaders from different geographic locations. Mentor team members and guide them as a technical and business SME and help them grow in their career. Serve as a mentor for career navigation and skills development for consultants in the broader organization who are not direct reports on your immediate team. Update your knowledge base with AI/ML advances Key Responsibilities Product Development: Lead the ideation, incubation, and scaling of innovative AI/ML products, ensuring alignment with business goals and client needs. Technical Leadership: Supervise and train a team of consultants in building advanced GenAI Product using large volumes of structured, semi-structured, and chaotic data. Prompt Engineering and Optimization: Develop and refine prompt engineering techniques to enhance model performance and user interaction. GenAI and Agent Architecture: Design and implement Generative AI applications using both open-source and closed-source Large Language Models (LLMs), focusing on agent architecture and integration. Collaboration: Work in a highly collaborative atmosphere with consultants and team leaders from different geographic locations, providing expert reviews and guidance. Qualifications and Required Skills Develop, review, and implement Solutions applying AI, Machine Learning, Deep Learning, and develop APIs using Python. Understanding and working knowledge of Agentic Skills and Deep Agent Frameworks Understanding and working knowledge of Agentic AI, Agent Development Frameworks like LangGraph/ LangChain. Lead the development and implementation of Generative AI applications using both open source (Llama, BERT, Mistral, etc.) and closed source (Open AI GPT models, Claude, Cohere etc.) Large Language Models (LLMS). Extensively work with advanced models such as GPT-3.5, GPT 4, Llama, BERT etc, for natural language processing and creative content generation using contextual information. Design and optimize solutions leveraging Vector databases for efficient storage and retrieval of contextual data for LLMs. RAG and Guardrails: Implement Retrieval-Augmented Generation techniques and establish guardrails to ensure the reliability and safety of AI models. Basic knowledge of Pre-Training / Finetuning Basic knowledge of MCP and A2A Minimum of 4-5 years of programming in Python Knowledge of RDBMS – Postgress / MySQL and NoSQL Databases. Provide expert reviews for all projects within the assigned subject. Ability to communicate with cross functional/competencies teams. messages.body: <external_source>Job invite from recruiter. Apply now! You've been chosen from a large pool of jobseekers to apply for this job. Make the most of this opportunity and stay ahead in your job search. Get app Surojit Dutta, you're invited to apply to this job Birla Institute Of Technology And Science Assistant Professor Bengaluru 4 - 9 years Not Disclosed Hybrid Deep Learning, MLOps, Data Science, GenAI, NLP, Devops, Cyber Security, Artificial Intelligence Apply now Job description Post / Job Title: Assistant Professor Job Type: Full Time No. of Positions : 3 Department : Academic Location: Bangalore Role Overview: The incumbent will play a pivotal role in shaping and delivering high-quality, industry-aligned educational content for our online courses and programmes. The role will include curriculum development, teaching, assessment, and ensuring the overall quality of programme delivery. Faculty members will also manage a large pool of guest/adjunct faculty and teaching assistants, ensuring consistency and excellence in course execution. Principal Accountabilities & Responsibilities Assist in the development of industry-aligned curricula under the guidance of senior faculty or programme directors. Teach and facilitate courses, focusing on delivering engaging learning experiences such as project-based learning. Grade assignments and assessments, providing timely feedback to students. Participate in guest/adjunct faculty coordination, helping ensure programme quality in collaboration with senior faculty. Collaborate with peers to improve courses and engage in departmental activities as appropriate. Stay up-to-date with developments and trends in relevant industries to ensure that courses reflect the most current practices, technologies, and skills. Skill and Ability Requirements Expertise in at least one of the following domain areas: Data Science, Machine Learning, Deep Learning, NLP, MLOps Strong programming skills in Python or R, with experience in ML frameworks (TensorFlow, PyTorch, Scikit-learn). Solid understanding of MLOps principles, including CI/CD for ML models, and model monitoring. Familiarity with MLOps and ML workflow orchestration tools. Experience using cloud-based AI services (AWS Sagemaker, Azure ML) would be an added advantage. LLMs, GenAI, Agentic AI, MLOps Strong programming skills in Python or R, with experience in ML frameworks (TensorFlow, PyTorch, Scikit-learn). Experience in developing LLM, GenAI or Agentic AI applications. Solid understanding of MLOps principles, including CI/CD for ML models, and model monitoring. Familiarity with MLOps and ML workflow orchestration tools. Knowledge of learning in LLMs, LLM distillation, Multiagent LLM, Multimodal LLMs, Reasoning in LLMs would be an added advantage. Cloud computing, DevOps Experience using Docker and Kubernetes. Application deployment on the cloud, cloud deployment models.
